claim: An exportable public certificate costs $7.00 per standard fully qualified domain name and $79.00 per wildcard name, charged upon issuance and again only on certificate renewal; with the reduction in validity from 395 to 198 days, AWS reduced these prices from $15/FQDN and $149/wildcard name.

qualifiers.scope: per name in an exportable public certificate
qualifiers.condition: charged upon issuance and again only on certificate renewal; an initial tier of 10,000 API calls for exportable certificates is available at no charge

evidence.quote: | Exportable public certificate (Per standard fully qualified domain name) | $7.00 (upon issuance and again only on certificate renewal) |
evidence.title: AWS Certificate Manager Pricing | Certificate Management | Amazon Web Services

evidence.quote: | Exportable public certificate (Per wildcard name) | $79.00 (upon issuance and again only on certificate renewal) |
evidence.title: AWS Certificate Manager Pricing | Certificate Management | Amazon Web Services

evidence.quote: With the reduction in the validity from 395 to 198 days, we have reduced our pricing from $149/wildcard name and $15/FQDN to $79 and $7, respectively.
evidence.title: AWS Certificate Manager FAQs | Certificate Management | Amazon Web Services

evidence.quote: Exportable public certificates are charged per domain at issuance and renewal. For both certificate types, an initial tier of API calls is available at no charge (30,000 for ACME; 10,000 for exportable), and subsequent 10,000 API call increments are charged per account per month.
